title: pvArrow
body:
## pvArrow

Creates a 3-D arrow of total length 1 along +x from the origin: a cylindrical shaft joined to a conical tip, as polydata without normals. Use it as a glyph shape or annotation; scale and orient it with a transform, or use pvGlyph to place many arrows on vector data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Normals are not generated, so the arrow renders faceted; apply the normals operation for smooth shading.
- TipLength, ShaftRadius and TipRadius are fractions of the unit arrow length, not absolute sizes.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Arrow`. Identity: `sources/ArrowSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Invert` | Inverts the arrow direction. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ShaftRadius` | This property specifies the radius of the shaft of the arrow (the cylinder). | `{"maximum":5.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ShaftResolution` | This property specifies the number of faces of the shaft of the arrow (the cylinder). As the resolution increases, the cylinder will become smoother. | `{"maximum":128,"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `TipLength` | This property specifies the length of the tip. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `TipRadius` | This property specifies the radius of the widest part of the tip of the arrow (the cone). | `{"maximum":10.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `TipResolution` | This property specifies the number of faces in the representation of the tip of the arrow (the cone). As the resolution increases, the cone will become smoother. | `{"maximum":128,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
